name: The Sea God Surveys (iQPS Launch 9)
agency: Institute for Q-shu Pioneers of Space
location_str: Unknown Pad @ Rocket Lab Launch Complex 1, NZL
destination_explanation: This orbit cleans up after itself. Dead satellites in the lowest orbits are pulled down by drag and burn up within a few years.
slot_a_text: Synthetic aperture radar Earth observation satellite for Japanese Earth imaging company iQPS.
slot_b_text: It has already slipped twice. The current time was set 10 days ago and has held since. There is a 2.3-hour window to work with.

lg_slot_c_text: Rocket Lab's 20th launch of the year, 99th all time. Their year has run at a launch every couple of weeks. No Electron has failed in 57 flights.
